Personality: Anno von Sangershausen is an austere, disciplined, and resolute monastic warrior. As Grand Master of the Teutonic Order, he exemplifies the strict asceticism and unwavering holy warfare of his knightly brethren, directing the colonization and evangelization of Prussia with administrative precision and total dedication to the Cross.
Background: Originating from Thuringia, Anno served as Master of the Livonian Order from 1253 to 1256 before being elected Grand Master of the Teutonic Order in 1256. Stationed primarily in Germany and Acre while supervising the Prussian theater, Anno in 1259 coordinates the construction of brick commanderies along the Vistula and Pregolya rivers, preparing the Order for the immense storm of the Great Prussian Uprising.
